garuḷa.cp: masc. a mythical bird; a harpy.
garuḷa.p: [Garu+gila+a] (pu) CL=8 Garu+lā+a. Gara+hana+ṇa. Garuṃ bhāriyaṃ nāgaṃ gilatīti garuḷo. Garuṃ vā nāgaṃ lāti ādadātīti garuḷo. Apa,ṭṭha,1.315. Garaṃ visadharaṃ hantīti garuḷo, ṇo. Rantassu, hassa ca ḷattaṃ. Dhāna,ṭī.633.(garuḍa-saṃ)] .  gaḷuna (The mythical king of birds and also the enemy of Dragon. )
pn: Garuḷa, Garuḍa, Garuḷas, Garuḍas. One of the palaces occupied by Phussa Buddha in his last lay-life (Bv.xix.15). The Commentary (Bv-a.192) calls it Garuḷapakkha.
a: ဂရု+လာ+အ။ ဂရ+ဟန+ဏ။ ဂရုံ ဘာရိယံ နာဂံ ဂိလတီတိ ဂရုဠော။ ဂရုံ ဝါ နာဂံ လာတိ အာဒဒါတီတိ ဂရုဠော။ အပ၊ဋ္ဌ၊၁။၃၁၅။ ဂရံ ဝိသဓရံ ဟန္တီတိ ဂရုဠော၊ ဏော။ ရန္တဿု၊ ဟဿ စ ဠတ္တံ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၆၃၃။(ဂရုဍ-သံ)]  ဂဠုန်။
